Computed tomography (CT) confirmed an avulsion fracture of the medial femoral condyle (MCL attachment) and a fracture of the fibular head (posterolateral corner injury). Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) demonstrated a full‐thickness PTR with a high‐signal hematoma along the tendon sheath (Figure 2). Preoperative analysis of the MRI suggested a complex rupture, though the specific split‐level bilaminar nature was fully appreciated only intraoperatively.
